<details>
This file is `.SRCINFO`, a purely declarative metadata file generated from the PKGBUILD. It contains no executable code, scripts, commands, or file operations of any kind, so there is nothing here capable of performing malicious actions.

The `source` field fetches the package's own declared upstream (the `url` matches: github.com/unhappychoice/steamfetch) at a pinned tag (`v0.5.8`), and a full SHA-256 checksum is provided rather than SKIP, which is good practice. The `makedepends` (rust, cargo) and `depends` (glibc, libgcc, openssl) are ordinary for a Rust application, and the `conflicts` entries simply reflect sibling variants of the same package (steamfetch-git, steamfetch-bin). No obfuscation, unexpected network destinations, exfiltration, or supply-chain red flags are present.
</details>
